title: althaea cachemiriana
intro: Althaea cachemiriana, commonly known as Kashmir plantain, is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae) that is native to the Himalayan region. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and wound-healing properties. Its therapeutic actions include soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and promoting tissue regeneration, making it a valuable remedy for skin conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Althaea cachemiriana include mucilages, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
